_comment: Retrieval-quality baseline (gold recall@k / MRR over a real local semantic embedder), NOT end-to-end LLM-judged QA accuracy — no generative LLM runs in this harness. Refreshed 2026-08-03 from a run on Apple M4 / macOS 26.5.2 / rustc 1.97.0; this refresh adds recall@10 and the per-seed recall@5 spread. The nightly gate (.github/workflows/benchmarks-nightly.yml) runs the Python locomo_runner and compares recall@10 by strategy against this file; note the gate is currently dormant because the nightly needs OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/HF secrets (issue #44) that are not set, and its strategy vocabulary (auto/vector_only/hybrid_rrf) is the Python runner's, not this Rust harness's mode labels. Reproduce these numbers: `ollama pull nomic-embed-text && cargo run --release -p mnemo-locomo-bench --bin semantic_recall_bench`.

embedder.note: real local semantic embedder — never NoopEmbedding

longmemeval_m_slice.seed_averaging: 5 in-process seeds (not restart-averaged); recall@5 min/max over seeds reported as recall@5_seed_min/max

results.note: lexical floor — loses to vector_only on every metric
mnemo's default auto fusion — LOSES to vector_only on MRR (0.604 vs 0.806) on this slice; the equal-weight RRF drags in BM25 candidates
held-out swept weights recover most of the MRR gap but still do not beat pure vector; graph lane weight is 0

token_efficiency.note: memory-layer token accounting only; QA accuracy needs a generative LLM (not run)

longmemeval_qa_accuracy.note: End-to-end LLM-judged QA accuracy (the Mem0/Letta/Hindsight leaderboard axis) is NOT measured here — requires a generative LLM + judge key. Left null on purpose; do not confuse with the retrieval rows above.
